meta.name: render-cartoon-music-video
meta.description: Assemble a cartoon / animated / hand-crafted music-video ad from a config — a sung song carries the whole narrative while N per-bar i2v clips (one recurring animated character, one look pack) are each cut to their BAR window from librosa beat-tracking and hard-concatenated on the bar, VEED-whisper white bold-sans captions in the BOTTOM third (Alignment 2, above the logo bug, no pill) burned from the song's word timings re-spelled against the locked lyrics, a persistent brand logo bug held over the body (suppressed on the end card), and closed on a solid-brand-color PIL end card with the song still playing under it — never AI-rendered text. This is the FREE deterministic assembly stage (cut-to-bar + hard concat + logo bug + captions + end card + song mux); the song, character, keyframes, and clips come from create-music-elevenlabs / create-image-fal / create-video-fal. Use for the cartoon-music-video format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把歌曲和动画素材自动拼成音乐视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用歌曲和动画素材自动生成带字幕和品牌标志的音乐视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble a cartoon music video ad from song and animation assets automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically produce a branded music video ad from a song and animated clips.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据配置自动组装卡通音乐视频广告：将每小节一个的动画片段按节拍拼接，添加歌词字幕和品牌水印，最后加上纯色结尾卡片，全程不调用付费服务。
howto.when: 当你提供歌曲、每小节的动画片段、品牌标志 SVG 以及歌词时间戳等素材，并要求制作卡通音乐视频时触发。

say.text: 用我提供的歌曲和动画片段，组装一个卡通音乐视频广告。
say.note: Claude 会按节拍拼接片段，添加字幕和水印。

say.text: 把这段歌曲和每小节的图片生成视频，再合成音乐视频。
say.note: Claude 会调用其他技能先生成动画片段，再组装。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can assemble a cartoon music-video ad from a config: it cuts per-bar i2v clips to their bar window, hard-concats them, burns captions and a logo bug, appends a solid-color end card, and muxes the song — all deterministically and free.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a song, per-bar animation clips, a brand logo SVG, and word timings, and ask to assemble a cartoon music video.

say_en.text: Assemble a cartoon music video ad using my song and animation clips.
say_en.note: Claude will cut clips to bars, add captions and logo.

say_en.text: Take this song and per-bar images, generate clips, then composite the music video.
say_en.note: Claude will call other skills to generate clips first, then assemble.
